parameters.text:
=You are a Voice of Customer analyst for an Amazon e-commerce brand.

Analyze the customer review provided below.

REVIEW INFORMATION

Review ID: {{ $json.review_id }}
ASIN: {{ $json.asin }}
Product: {{ $json.product_name }}
Rating: {{ $json.rating }} out of 5
Review title: {{ $json.review_title }}
Review text: {{ $json.review_text }}
Verified purchase: {{ $json.verified_purchase }}
Helpful votes: {{ $json.helpful_votes }}

ANALYSIS INSTRUCTIONS

1. Determine the overall sentiment.
2. Assign a sentiment score from -1 to 1.
3. Identify one primary review theme.
4. Explain the customer's main issue.
5. Identify any positive signal in the review.
6. Identify the improvement requested or implied by the customer.
7. Assign the severity.
8. Identify the business team responsible for the issue.
9. Determine whether the review presents an Amazon listing-content opportunity.
10. Determine whether the review presents an advertising-creative opportunity.
11. Recommend one practical business action.
12. Give a confidence score from 0 to 1.

Use only the information contained in the customer review.

Do not invent product information or customer motivations.

Allowed sentiment values:
positive
neutral
mixed
negative

Allowed severity values:
low
medium
high
critical

Allowed responsible_team values:
product
packaging
operations
customer_support
listing_content
marketing
fulfillment
none

Primary themes should use short reusable names such as:
product_effectiveness
packaging
capsule_size
dosage_information
listing_confusion
delivery_damage
value_for_money
customer_service
ingredients
taste
ease_of_use
feature_request
general_satisfaction

If no customer issue exists, return "none".

If no positive signal exists, return "none".

If no desired improvement exists, return "none".

parameters.content:
## 1. REVIEW INGESTION

Loads customer-review records from the demonstration data source.
Only records with a NEW processing status enter the analysis pipeline.

## 2. DATA QUALITY & VALIDATION

Standardizes ratings, helpful votes, boolean values and text fields.
Invalid or incomplete review records are prevented from reaching the AI layer.

## 3. CONTROLLED PROCESSING

Processes reviews one at a time to maintain correct item pairing,
reduce rate-limit risk and prevent review data from becoming mixed.

## 4. AI VOICE-OF-CUSTOMER ANALYSIS

Classifies sentiment, themes, customer issues, positive signals,
desired improvements and business opportunities.

A structured-output schema keeps every AI response consistent.

## 5. TRANSPARENT PRIORITY ENGINE

Calculates an auditable 0–100 urgency score using rating,
severity, helpful votes and AI confidence.

Priority levels: Low, Medium, High and Critical.

## 6. STORAGE, ALERTING & STATUS CONTROL

Upserts structured analysis using review_id as the unique key.
High-risk reviews generate an immediate alert.
Successfully completed reviews are marked ANALYZED.

## 7. INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY

After all new reviews are processed, the system aggregates sentiment,
priority levels, ratings, alerts and customer themes into a summary record.
